# k2_clean_v4.csv — Data Dictionary

**File:** `data/k2_clean_v4.csv`
**Rows:** 1,020 trading days · **Columns:** 228
**Coverage:** 2021-01-06 → 2024-12-30 · **Frequency:** daily (business days)
**Key:** `DATE` (ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`)
**Generated by:** `bbg_merge_v2.py` merging Bloomberg Tier-1/Tier-2 pulls into the K2E-provided base dataset, with GIE storage and derived calendar/anomaly features.

---

## Naming conventions

| Prefix | Source / family |
|---|---|
| `BM_` | K2E Bloomberg-sourced market prices (opens, closes, volumes for front-month / CAL-1) |
| `IM_` | K2E intelligence/market file (spot prices, coal-gas switch levels, options) |
| `MF_COT_*` | ESMA Commitment of Traders positioning (via K2E market feed) |
| `MF_` (non-COT) | Market fundamentals — consumption, load, weather, generation, flows, storage |
| `DERIVED_` | Engineered deviations from seasonal normals or residual-load decompositions |
| `CAL_` | Calendar encodings (day of week, month, quarter, Monday/Friday dummies) |
| `GIE_*_FULL/INJECTION/…` | GIE gas-storage fundamentals (EU and DE) via `gie_fetcher.py` |
| `BBG_PX_`, `BBG_VOL_`, `BBG_OI_` | Bloomberg Tier-1 price / volume / open-interest passthroughs |
| `BBG_LR_`, `D_BBG_`, `D_LOG_` | Derived log-returns, first differences, daily log-changes |
| `BBG_IV_`, `BBG_IVOL_` | Implied-volatility surface (25Δ/50Δ put/call, ATM, risk-reversal, butterfly) |
| `BBG_COT_EUA_` | Bloomberg ESMA-COT derived EUA positioning (plumbing kept; dropped from live model — collinear with `MF_COT_EUA_*`) |

**Unit suffixes:** `_EUR_MWH`, `_EUR_TON`, `_USD_BBL`, `_USD_MMBTU`, `_USD_TON`, `_GWH_D`, `_GW`, `_TWH`, `_C` (°C), `_PCT`, `_RATIO`.
**Derived-transform suffixes:** `D_` = first difference, `_Z20` = 20-day rolling z-score, `_DOY_DEV` = deviation from day-of-year expanding mean, `_DOY_EXPAND_MEAN` = the day-of-year expanding baseline itself, `_FFILL` = forward-filled (≤3 days) to patch small gaps.

| `BM_GERMANY_POWER_CAL1_OPEN_EUR_MWH` / `_CLOSE_` / `_VOLUME_MWH` | €/MWh, MWh | German baseload power calendar-year-ahead. |
| `BM_EUA_CO2_CAL1_PRICE_EUR_TON` | €/tCO₂ | EU emission allowance (EUA) CAL-1 settlement. |

## 4. ESMA COT positioning — TTF (`MF_COT_TTF_*`)

Weekly ESMA trader positioning on TTF futures, broadcast daily (step-function; Fridays update). All values in MWh-equivalents. Category definitions follow ESMA reporting taxonomy.

| Category suffix | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `HEDGE_FUNDS_{LONG,SHORT,NET}_MWH` | Hedge-fund gross long, gross short, net (long − short). |
| `COMMERCIAL_{LONG,SHORT,NET}_MWH` | Physical commercial positions. |
| `COMMERCIAL_RISK_REDUCING_{LONG,SHORT,NET}_MWH` | Subset of commercials flagged as risk-reducing. |
| `INVESTMENT_FIRMS_OR_CREDIT_INSTITUTIONS_{LONG,SHORT,NET}_MWH` | IF/CI category (banks, investment managers). |
| `OTHER_FINANCIAL_INSTITUTIONS_{LONG,SHORT,NET}_MWH` | Residual financial. |
| `TOTAL_{LONG,SHORT,NET}_MWH` | All categories summed. |

(15 columns total for TTF.)

---

## 9. GIE gas-storage fundamentals (`GIE_*`)

Pulled from `gie_fetcher.py` against the AGSI+ / ALSI public API.

### EU aggregate
| Column | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GIE_EU_FULL` | % | Aggregate EU storage fill level. |
| `GIE_EU_INJECTION` | GWh/day | Gross injection into storage. |
| `GIE_EU_WITHDRAWAL` | GWh/day | Gross withdrawal from storage. |
| `GIE_EU_NETWITHDRAWAL` | GWh/day | `WITHDRAWAL − INJECTION` (positive = destocking). |
| `GIE_EU_GASINSTORAGE` | TWh | Absolute volume in storage. |
| `GIE_EU_CONSUMPTIONFULL` | TWh | Working-gas capacity × fullness. |
| `GIE_EU_TREND` | — | GIE-reported 7d directional flag (increasing / stable / decreasing). |
| `GIE_EU_FULL_DOY_EXPAND_MEAN` | % | Expanding mean of fill-level by day-of-year (seasonal benchmark). |
| `GIE_EU_FULL_DOY_DEV` | % | `GIE_EU_FULL` minus the DOY benchmark (storage anomaly). |

### Germany (DE)
Same schema (`GIE_DE_FULL`, `GIE_DE_INJECTION`, `GIE_DE_WITHDRAWAL`, `GIE_DE_NETWITHDRAWAL`, `GIE_DE_GASINSTORAGE`, `GIE_DE_CONSUMPTIONFULL`, `GIE_DE_TREND`, `GIE_DE_FULL_DOY_EXPAND_MEAN`, `GIE_DE_FULL_DOY_DEV`) plus:

| Column | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GIE_DE_OUT_PLANNED_GWH_D` | GWh/day | Planned storage-facility outages (DE). |
| `GIE_DE_OUT_UNPLANNED_GWH_D` | GWh/day | Unplanned outages. |
| `GIE_DE_OUT_N_EVENTS` | count | Number of concurrent outage events. |

## 10. Bloomberg Tier-1 price / volume / open-interest (`BBG_PX_*`, `BBG_VOL_*`, `BBG_OI_*`)

Passthrough of Bloomberg tickers as pulled in `KtE_BBG_Data_Extract-1.xlsx`. Each ticker has a `PX`, `VOL`, and `OI` column (not every combination is populated).

| Ticker | `BBG_PX_…` maps to |
|---|---|
| `TZTA` | TTF generic front month (M1) |
| `TZTB` | TTF M2 |
| `TZT1` | TTF further-out (used for M1–M3 spread) |
| `FNA` | NBP (UK gas) M1 |
| `FNB` | NBP M2 |
| `MO1` | EUA front month |
| `MO2` | EUA M2 |
| `BDIY` | Baltic Dry Index |
| `TMR1` | TTF monthly contract (alt) |
| `TTFG1MON` | TTF G1 month index |
| `RTEGNUCT` | RTE French nuclear generation total |
| `RTEGNUCD` | RTE French nuclear generation daily |
| `XA1` | Rotterdam coal front (API2) |
| `XAA` | Rotterdam coal alt |
| `EEXXT3PA` | EUA auction (EEX) |
| `ELGB1MON` | UK base power front-month |
| `ELGP1MON` | UK peak power front-month |
| `DBRST3PA` | EUA auction (alternate series — Deutsche Börse) |

Volume (`BBG_VOL_*`) and open interest (`BBG_OI_*`) are reported for the liquid subset: `TZTA`, `TZTB`, `TZT1`, `FNA`, `FNB`, `MO1`, `MO2`, `XA1`. `BBG_IVOL_MO1` is a single-point EUA implied-vol series (historical call IV).

**Coverage note:** BBG columns are forward-filled up to 3 business days to paper over isolated vendor gaps. Dead/empty tickers (`TTFDDAHD`, `API21MON`, `DEBM A`, `DEPK A`) were dropped at merge time.

## 11. Derived BBG features — term structure, positioning, returns

| Column | Definition |
|---|---|
| `BBG_LR_TTF_M1_M2` | `log(PX_TZTB / PX_TZTA)` — TTF M2/M1 spread; **positive = contango**. |
| `BBG_LR_NBP_M1_M2` | Same for NBP (`FNB / FNA`). |
| `BBG_LR_EUA_M1_M2` | Same for EUA (`MO2 / MO1`). |
| `BBG_LR_TTF_M1_M3` | `log(PX_TZT1 / PX_TZTA)` — wider TTF term structure. |
| `D_BBG_LR_TTF_M1_M2` / `_NBP_M1_M2` / `_EUA_M1_M2` / `_TTF_M1_M3` | Daily first differences of the above (stationary signal). |
| `D_LOG_OI_{TZTA,MO1,XA1,TZT1}` | Daily log-change in open interest for the named front contract. |
| `D_LOG_VOL_{TZTA,MO1,XA1,TZT1}` | Daily log-change in traded volume for the named front contract. |
| `D_BBG_IVOL_MO1` | Daily change in EUA implied vol. |
| `BBG_IVOL_MO1_Z20` | 20-day rolling z-score of EUA implied vol. |
| `BBG_LR_EUA_AUCTION_VS_MO1` | `log(EUA_auction / MO1)` — auction-to-futures spread. Uses `EEXXT3PA` if populated, else `DBRST3PA`. |
| `BBG_LR_POWER_BASE_PEAK` | `log(ELGP1MON / ELGB1MON)` — UK peak-to-base spread (proxy for intraday shape stress). |
| `BBG_LR_COAL_XA1` | Daily log return of Rotterdam coal front (`XA1`). |
| `D_BBG_PX_RTEGNUCD` | Daily change in French nuclear daily-output ticker (supply shock for POWER). |
| `D_BBG_PX_RTEGNUCT` | Daily change in French nuclear total-output ticker. |
| `BBG_LR_BDIY` | Daily log return of Baltic Dry Index (freight/coal-flow proxy). |

## 12. Implied-volatility surface (`BBG_IV_*`)

Built in `bbg_merge_v2.py` from the `Option` sheet of `KtE_BBG_Data_Extract-1.xlsx`. Available for two underlyings: **MO1 (EUA front)** and **TZT1 (TTF generic front)**.

### Raw 4-point surface (per underlying `UL` ∈ {TTF, EUA})
| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `BBG_IV_{UL}_PUT_IV_25D` | 25-delta put implied vol. |
| `BBG_IV_{UL}_CALL_IV_25D` | 25-delta call implied vol. |
| `BBG_IV_{UL}_PUT_IV_50D` | 50-delta (ATM) put IV. |
| `BBG_IV_{UL}_CALL_IV_50D` | 50-delta (ATM) call IV. |

### Derived surface features (per underlying)
| Column | Definition |
|---|---|
| `BBG_IV_{UL}_ATM` | `(PUT_IV_50D + CALL_IV_50D) / 2` — at-the-money IV level. |
| `BBG_IV_{UL}_RR25` | `CALL_IV_25D − PUT_IV_25D` — 25Δ **risk reversal** (skew). Negative ⇒ put-skew / tail-risk premium. |
| `BBG_IV_{UL}_BF25` | `(PUT_IV_25D + CALL_IV_25D)/2 − ATM` — 25Δ **butterfly** (convexity / wings richness). |
| `D_BBG_IV_{UL}_ATM` | Daily change in ATM. |
| `D_BBG_IV_{UL}_RR25` | Daily change in RR. |
| `BBG_IV_{UL}_ATM_Z20` | 20-day rolling z-score of ATM. |
| `BBG_IV_{UL}_RR25_Z20` | 20-day rolling z-score of RR. |

**Coverage caveat:** MO1 has a ~2021–2023 data hole and TZT1 a ~2022–2023 hole on the vendor side. These features are present but partly-missing; the live model does not currently rely on them.

## 13. BBG ESMA COT — EUA (`BBG_COT_EUA_*`)

Bloomberg's alternative rendering of ESMA COT for EUA, Futures+Options (F+O / "G3") basis. Speculator proxy = "Investment Funds"; hedger proxy = "Commercial Undertakings". **These columns are present but excluded from the live model** — found to be collinear with the `MF_COT_EUA_*` block already in use (regressed performance on EUA). Kept for future interaction/regime-gated experiments.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `BBG_COT_EUA_SPEC_NET_FO` | Speculator net (long − short), F+O. |
| `BBG_COT_EUA_SPEC_LONG_FO` / `_SHORT_FO` | Speculator gross long / short. |
| `BBG_COT_EUA_SPEC_LONG_PCTOI_FO` / `_SHORT_PCTOI_FO` | Speculator long/short as % of open interest. |
| `BBG_COT_EUA_HEDGE_NET_FO` / `_LONG_FO` / `_SHORT_FO` | Hedger (commercial) equivalents. |
| `BBG_COT_EUA_IF_NET_FO` | Investment-firm net. |
| `BBG_COT_EUA_OFI_NET_FO` | Other-financial-institutions net. |
| `D_BBG_COT_EUA_SPEC_NET_FO` | Weekly-to-daily first difference of `SPEC_NET_FO`. |
| `BBG_COT_EUA_SPEC_NET_Z52` | 52-week rolling z-score of speculator net position. |
| `BBG_COT_EUA_SPEC_NET_PCTGROSS` | Speculator net as % of gross (long+short). |
| `D_BBG_COT_EUA_HEDGE_NET_FO` | First difference of hedger net. |

---

## Conventions & caveats

- **Causality / lagging.** This file contains raw observations as-of-date. All lag enforcement (to prevent look-ahead) happens inside the feature builder in `K2E_Model_V4_3.py` — never assume rows in this CSV are already aligned to a forecast target.
- **Forward-fills.** Only applied where the source is structurally daily but has isolated vendor gaps (e.g., `BBG_*` columns, ≤3 business days). Do not confuse `_FFILL` columns with engineered imputation.
- **Weekly → daily.** COT data is published weekly (ESMA: Fridays); values are held constant between publications. The `D_*` differenced versions will show step-function behaviour.
- **Units.** Mixed units are preserved for transparency — standardisation is performed at modelling time (see `K2E_Model_V4_2.make_X_y`).
- **Coverage drop-off.** IV surface and `BBG_COT_EUA_*` families have vendor-side gaps; expect `NaN` coverage in 2021–2023 specifically.
